sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Official Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M (~16.8 GB) + a harvested uncensored SYSTEM pack. GitHub cannot host the weights. Download the GGUF below, or pull the Ollama tag — this repo bakes the residual so ollama run stays uncensored.

sources.snippet: Alibaba's Qwen team has released ' Qwen3.8-27B, ' an AI model with 27 billion parameters. The model's weights are released under the Apache License 2.0, and commercial use is permitted ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.
